title: Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Amendment Ordinance 1983

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE IV OF 1983
PAKISTAN
INTERNATIONAL AIRLINES CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
ORDINANCE IV OF 1983
An Ordinance
further to amend the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Act, 1956
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd February 1983]
No. F. 17(1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Pakistan international Airlines Corporation (Amendment) Ordi nance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Amendment Ordinance 1983
sections.description:
Amendment of section 6, Act XIX of 1956

ORDINANCE IV OF 1983
PAKISTAN
INTERNATIONAL AIRLINES CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
ORDINANCE IV OF 1983
An Ordinance
further to amend the Pakistan International Airlines Corporation Act, 1956
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd February 1983]
No. F. 17(1)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 6, Act
XIX of 1956.-In the Pakistan Interna tional Airlines Corporation Act, 1956
(XIX of 1956), in section 6, in sub section (1)-
(a) for the word "ten"
the word "eleven" shall be substituted ; and
(b) in clause (b), for the word
"seven" the word "eight" shall be substituted.
